items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: I used to come back through there, and I'd have a chance to sit down and talk to him, and he would tell me about the young violin players and the young cello players.

ctx.x: So now I'm seeing guys like Mister Elgar and a couple of these guys from New Orleans, and they always was doing very good, and looked like they'd be... They'd be out to the union, but they didn't look like they was really hurting for anything. And I asked you, I said, 'Well, how are these making it?' And you told me that these guys were... Do you remember what you told me?
